title: Towards Efficient Multimodal and Multilingual Opinion Extraction for STI: A QLoRA-Based Fine-Tuning Approach
abstract: arXiv:2608.14152v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have reshaped semantic analysis. Opinion Extraction (OE) for Science and Technology Intelligence (STI) requires concise core opinions from large information streams. Off-the-shelf models struggle to filter noise from these streams and show limited structured-output reliability in zero-shot multilingual and multi-modal settings. To address information overload and extraction defocus, this study proposes a multimodal core-opinion extraction framework in which visual evidence serves as a contextual anchor for textual judgment. Using VideoLLaMA2 (VL2) and VideoLLaMA2.1 (VL2.1) as the base models, we apply Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA) fine-tuning on a curated dataset of 2,194 multilingual and multimodal samples. Under the selected Image-Augmented setting, fine-tuned VL2.1 generates structured JSON core-opinion outputs, achieving 64.98% Precision, 42.15% Recall, 51.14% F1-score, and 74.0

translated_title: 面向STI的高效多模态与多语言观点抽取：基于QLoRA的微调方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14152v1 公告类型：新 摘要：大型语言模型（LLMs）的最新进展重塑了语义分析。面向科技情报（STI）的观点抽取（OE）需要从大量信息流中提取简洁的核心观点。现成模型难以过滤这些信息流中的噪声，并且在零样本多语言和多模态设置中表现出有限的结构化输出可靠性。为解决信息过载和抽取聚焦不足的问题，本研究提出了一种多模态核心观点抽取框架，其中视觉证据作为文本判断的上下文锚点。以VideoLLaMA2（VL2）和VideoLLaMA2.1（VL2.1）为基础模型，我们在包含2,194个多语言和多模态样本的精选数据集上应用量化低秩适应（QLoRA）微调。在选定的图像增强设置下，微调后的VL2.1生成结构化JSON核心观点输出，实现了64.98%的精确率、42.15%的召回率、51.14%的F1分数和74.0%的...（摘要截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于QLoRA微调的多模态观点抽取框架，利用视觉证据作为上下文锚点，显著提升了多语言和多模态环境下核心观点抽取的结构化输出可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a QLoRA-based multimodal opinion extraction framework that uses visual evidence as contextual anchors, significantly improving structured-output reliability for core opinion extraction in multilingual and multimodal settings.
